Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

message — a short piece of communication. Example: I send ten messages a day.
text — a short written message on a mobile. Example: I write short texts to my friends.
email — a message you send by computer. Example: I check my email every morning.
send — to make something go to a person. Example: Send me the photos.
receive — to get something. Example: I receive about twenty messages a day.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I send a message.
• Did you receive it?
• Send me the photos.
• I answer in the evening.
• Thanks for your message.
